title: E. Nash 3BR Escape | Walkable | Family Friendly
description:
Modern 3-floor townhome in vibrant East Nashville - walk to Grimey's Records, Living Water Brewery, and Elegy Coffee. Sleeps 9 across 3 bedrooms (king, queen, and a kid-friendly bunk room) plus a sofa sleeper, with 3.5 baths so no one waits. Open-concept kitchen and living space, free parking for multiple cars, high-speed Wi-Fi, smart TVs, and an in-unit washer/dryer. Self check-in with a smart lock. About 13 minutes to Broadway and 10 to BNA Airport, with easy Uber/Lyft/Waymo access.

The space
This three-story East Nashville townhome is built for groups who want room to spread out without sacrificing style.

The main level is an open-concept kitchen and living room with a fully equipped kitchen (island seating for 4, Keurig and drip coffee makers, blender, and toaster), two sofas - one a sleeper for 2 additional guests - leather armchairs, smart TVs, a window-side desk nook for remote work, a half bath, and a private balcony.

On the third floor you'll find two bedrooms: a queen room with its own smart TV and private bath (shower/tub combo), and the primary suite with a king bed, smart TV, walk-in closet, and an en-suite double vanity bath with a custom-tile standing shower. The in-unit washer and dryer are also on this floor.

On the ground floor, a bunk room with a twin-over-full bed (sleeps 3) sits just steps from its own full bath with a pedestal sink and tiled standing shower - ideal for kids or anyone who'd rather skip the stairs to bed.

Heating and air conditioning run on separate smart-thermostat-controlled zones for upstairs and downstairs, so everyone stays comfortable.

Guest access
You'll have the entire unit to yourselves - a private, fully self-contained townhome with no shared interior spaces. Self check-in is available via smart lock, so you can head straight in on arrival. Parking includes one covered carport spot, plus access to two additional first-come, first-served spots on the property, with free street parking nearby as a backup.

Other things to note
Check-in is at 4:00 PM and check-out is at 10:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out may be possible by approval for a $25/hour fee - we can't guarantee or approve these in advance.
Pack-n-play and high-chair stocked in home.
This is a three-story home; stairs are required to access all levels (no elevator).
Maximum occupancy is 9 guests.
Pets are not permitted.
Please respect neighbors and observe local quiet hours.
